comparator.name: BSc Economics and Business Economics — Economics profile
comparator.sourceNotes: The normalized target is the generic 180-EC Economics and Business Economics bachelor. The current official curriculum has a shared 60-EC first year, three formal profiles from Year 2, a 30-EC third-year minor or study-abroad block, four 5-EC profile courses and a 10-EC thesis. The Economics profile is instantiated because it is the least specialized and most general continuation of the shared programme. For its Year 3 choice rule, the pathway takes all four named Economics profile courses rather than substituting an elective.

alternativeSelection.assessment: The closest route covers the general Economics profile and its shared quantitative core. The two remaining formal generator-backed profiles, Business Economics and International Economics and Sustainable Development, both yield coherent and feasible UCR curricula with materially different course sets. Three alternatives are therefore included, which is the maximum.
